dolomites-sella-ronda-pass-circuit.title: Dolomites · Sella Ronda Pass Circuit
dolomites-sella-ronda-pass-circuit.story: Four iconic passes, rock walls and pure alpine theatre. 118 km round from Selva - plan on about 2 h 16 of riding. The climbs: Sella Pass, Pordoi Pass and Campolongo Pass. It tops out at about 2,250 m. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Watchtower WP 4/81 → Fortlet Lochmühle
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 36 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
